metadata.name: Mirror Induction Technique
metadata.author: Example Modder
metadata.description: A subtle mirroring technique that induces trance through matching body language and speech patterns. Less obvious than direct methods but requires patience.

technique_data.name: Mirror Induction
technique_data.description: Subtly mirror the target's body language, breathing, and speech patterns to build unconscious rapport and induce a light trance state.

high_rapport_bonus.description: Deep trust makes mirroring feel natural

rushed_penalty.description: Mirroring requires time to work effectively

high_suspicion_penalty.description: They're watching your behavior too closely

stages.name: Observation
stages.description: Carefully observe target's baseline behavior, breathing rate, posture, and speech patterns.

stages.name: Matching
stages.description: Begin subtly matching their patterns - breathing rhythm, posture shifts, word choices.

stages.name: Leading
stages.description: Gradually shift your patterns - if they follow unconsciously, rapport is established.

stages.name: Suggestion
stages.description: With behavioral rapport established, plant suggestion in their synchronized state.

special_effects.rapport_preservation_desc: Even if detected, seems like natural mirroring rather than manipulation (+5 rapport loss mitigation)
special_effects.trust_bonus: Successful use grants +2 rapport even without PHS

advanced_unlock.description: Master the technique to unlock Deep Mirror Induction

dialogue.start: You settle into the conversation, carefully observing {target}'s natural rhythms...
dialogue.stage_1_success: You've identified their baseline patterns. Time to match them.
dialogue.stage_2_success: Your breathing syncs with theirs. They don't notice consciously.
dialogue.stage_3_success: You shift your posture slightly... and they mirror YOU. Perfect.
dialogue.stage_3_failure: They don't follow your lead. The rapport isn't deep enough yet.
dialogue.stage_4_success: In this synchronized state, your suggestion flows naturally into their mind.
dialogue.detected: {target} pauses. 'Why are you copying me?' The technique is blown.
dialogue.success: The suggestion is planted seamlessly. They felt only a comfortable conversation.
dialogue.failure: You couldn't establish the necessary behavioral rapport. The technique fails.

tips: Requires patience - don't rush the stages
Can build genuine rapport even without PHS
Avoid using on defensive or anxious targets
